st_marees.name: Pointe des Cristaux
st_marees.alt: A sunny rocky headland on a wild coast, close under a red-and-white striped lighthouse, with gorse, sea-pinks, gulls and rocky islets, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe stands on a boulder like a town crier, ringing a bell and holding up a sealed scroll; hangs a flower garland on the lighthouse railing in a green beret; bows with a puppy to teach it manners; turns a big round cheese on a board; kneels by a rock pool glittering with salt crystals; and compares a round shell with a spiky one. The cliff path on the left leads back to the valley. The yellow door in the rock, the blue lighthouse door and the green gate above the cove steps lead on.

doors.hint: Down through the yellow door in the rock

doors.label: Crique du Pull-Rétréci

porte_voix.name: Balcon des Porte-Voix
porte_voix.alt: The high balcony at the top of the lighthouse, by the great glass lantern, looking far out over a turquoise sea and rocky islets: Monsieur Verbe slumps worn out on a bench beside his rucksack after the climb, watches a puddle dry up and shrink in the sunshine, sets his finest shell on a red velvet cushion, shouts out to sea through a megaphone, and kneels to give a cat a fresh fish beside its empty plate. The blue door in the lighthouse wall on the left leads back down.

doors.label: Pointe des Cristaux
doors.hint: Back down through the blue lighthouse door

chavires.name: Rochers des Chavirés
chavires.alt: Flat rocks and rock pools at low tide below the sea cliffs, with the lighthouse on its rock across the water: Monsieur Verbe draws a card from a deck on a flat rock, hugs all the seaside buckets for himself, calmly shaves in a little rowboat that is filling with water and tipping over, holds up a tangled rope made into one simple loop, and frowns at a hanging scale whose needle is in the red under a heavy basket of fish. The yellow door in the cliff on the left leads back up.

doors.label: Pointe des Cristaux
doors.hint: Back up through the yellow door in the cliff

pull_retreci.name: Crique du Pull-Rétréci
pull_retreci.alt: A small sandy cove between the rocks, with the lighthouse just across the water and a washing line on driftwood poles: Monsieur Verbe is drenched by a wave crashing over him and the rocks, holds up a shrunken striped jumper in a green beret, cheers with a pom-pom while pulling a brass telescope out longer and longer, splits a gray cinder block in two with a hammer and chisel, and checks his pocket watch while rolling a long scroll up short. The green gate at the top of the steps on the left leads back up.

doors.label: Pointe des Cristaux
doors.hint: Back up through the green gate
